title: 1 Timothy 6:10 — the love of money is the root of all evil
summary: 1 Timothy 6:10 in English with its Greek reference: the love of money is the root of all evil, and some who coveted after it have erred from the faith and pierced themselves through with many sorrows. 'love' is in red, 'money' in green and 'all evil' is enlarged.

text.text: 10 For the love of money is the root of all evil: which while some coveted after, they have erred from the faith, and pierced themselves through with many sorrows.
